sections.title: 0:00–1:00 · Sustained Vowels
sections.instructions:
Start on a comfortable middle note. Hold each sound for about 3 seconds.
Ahhhhh
Ehhhhhh
Eeeeeee
Ohhhhh
Ooooooo
Move slightly lower and repeat:
Ahhhhh
Eeeeeee
Ohhhhh
Ooooooo
Move slightly higher and finish with two natural vibrato holds:
Ahhhhh
Eeeeeee
Ahhhhh - with natural vibrato
Ohhhhh - with natural vibrato
Timing cue: Keep the holds near 3 seconds and take only a short breath between sounds.
Do not force high notes.

sections.title: 1:00–2:15 · Smooth Scales
sections.instructions:
Sing each line as a smooth up-and-down five-note melody:
1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - 5 - 4 - 3 - 2 - 1
Ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah
Ee - ee - ee - ee - ee - ee - ee - ee - ee
Oh - oh - oh - oh - oh - oh - oh - oh - oh
Nay - nay - nay - nay - nay - nay - nay - nay - nay
Repeat the four lines once a little higher, then once a little lower.
Timing cue: Use a steady comfortable tempo. Each pass should take about 20-25 seconds.

sections.title: 2:15–3:15 · Arpeggios and Pitch Jumps
sections.instructions:
Sing a wider pattern: low - middle - high - highest - high - middle - low.
Ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah - ah
Hey - hey - hey - hey - hey - hey - hey
Mum - mum - mum - mum - mum - mum - mum
Now make clear, comfortable jumps:
Low AH - high AH - low AH
Low EE - high EE - low EE
Low OH - high OH - low OH
Low HEY - high HEY - low HEY
Timing cue: Move continuously through the patterns. Use comfortable high notes, not your absolute limit.

sections.title: 3:15–5:30 · Project X Phonetic Singing Passage
sections.instructions:
Sing these as real melodic lines, not spoken sentences. Make up a simple comfortable melody.

Baby, bring the daylight back to me.
Take another road and tell me where you've been.
Golden skies are shining through the rain.
Sweet summer winds are moving through the trees.
Charlie chased a shadow through the night.
Every little memory stays with me.
Sing it softly, sing it strong and clear.
Hold me close and never let me go.
Walking down the road beneath the moon.
Bright blue morning, burning through the gray.
Whisper every word and sing it true.
I can hear you calling me back home.

Now repeat the final four lines with a different melody.
Timing cue: Aim for roughly 7-8 seconds per line. Leave a natural breath between phrases.

sections.title: 5:30–6:45 · Soft, Normal and Strong Voice
sections.instructions:
Use this line:
I can hear the river calling my name.
Sing it:
Softly.
Normally.
Strongly.
Softly with natural vibrato.
Strongly with natural vibrato.
Smooth and connected.
Short and rhythmic.
Then use:
Stay with me tonight.
Sing it once low, once in your normal range, and once in your comfortable upper range.
Timing cue: Do not rush the changes. Let each version sound clearly different.

sections.title: 6:45–7:45 · Fast Words and Articulation
sections.instructions:
Sing this at a moderately fast tempo:
Running down the highway with the radio playing,
everybody's talking but I don't hear what they're saying.
Turn another corner, see the morning light,
we're gonna keep on moving through the middle of the night.
Repeat the four lines once using a different melody or rhythm. Accuracy matters more than speed.
Timing cue: First pass about 25 seconds; second pass about 25 seconds; use the remaining time for a clean repeat of any difficult line.

sections.title: 7:45–8:45 · Attacks, Consonants and Short Notes
sections.instructions:
Sing these as short rhythmic phrases:
Ba - ba - ba - ba - baby
Pa - pa - pa - pa - paper
Da - da - da - da - daylight
Ta - ta - ta - ta - take me
Ga - ga - ga - ga - going
Ka - ka - ka - ka - carry
Fa - fa - fa - fa - falling
Va - va - va - va - valley
Then sing:
Mee - may - mah - moh - moo
Nee - nay - nah - noh - noo
Lee - lay - lah - loh - loo
Timing cue: Keep the notes short and clear. Do not over-pronounce; use your normal singing voice.

sections.title: 8:45–10:00 · Natural Singing
sections.instructions:
For the final section, stop doing exercises. Sing naturally as though you were recording a real song.
About 25 seconds - comfortable verse voice.
About 25 seconds - stronger chorus voice.
About 15 seconds - comfortable upper singing voice.
Use the remaining time to sing whatever makes you sound most recognizably like yourself.
You may improvise your own words or use these original Project X lines:
I've been walking through the changes,
I've been waiting for the sun.
Every road became a memory,
every ending had begun.
So carry me home through the darkness,
carry me home through the storm.

finish_standard.title: Finish Standard
finish_standard.text: Target: approximately 10–20 minutes. A clean, natural performance with useful range, vowels, consonants, transitions, sustained notes, dynamics, and real singing is more valuable than a perfect performance. This voice capture should sound like the customer — relaxed, recognizable, and repeatable.
